clue.text: Ultimately, saddest tear to go viral

blocks.note: the final letter of saddest
to rend is to tear apart

explanation.surface: A heartbreaking tearful moment spreads across the internet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tear' reads as the drop from a crying eye, but it is the verb meaning rip.
explanation.definitionFit: To trend is to become suddenly popular online, which is exactly what spreading virally means.

clue.text: Locates characters up to four times in an election-night report

indicators.note: the letters of the word may each be reused, up to four times apiece, and arranged in any order

fourth use of one character, the limit the clue allows

explanation.surface: A tally of where characters appear, repeated four times over, on election night.
explanation.walkthrough: An unusual device: TOO CLOSE TO CALL uses only the letters of LOCATES, with O appearing four times, L three times and the others fewer.
explanation.definitionFit: Broadcasters say a race is too close to call when the vote counts are tied so tightly no winner can be projected.

clue.text: Home for some Europeans drifting into sea

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Migrants' homes are floating out to sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Estonia is a Baltic country, the homeland of the Estonians, who are Europeans.

clue.text: Intended to rise up and corral man losing head to Alzheimer's, perhaps

indicators.note: in a down entry, rising up means reading the letters from bottom to top
losing its head means the word's first letter is removed

a gent is a man

explanation.surface: A plan to stage an uprising and round up a man whose mind is failing.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'rise up' means the word is read from the bottom upward; 'losing head' drops only the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Alzheimer's disease is the most common cause of dementia, so it is an example of the condition.

clue.text: Those who aren't expert mostly gather to admit true failing

taken as written

explanation.surface: Novices tend to gather and confess that something genuine has gone wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: AMASS loses its last letter to become AMAS, which then takes in the scrambled TRUE.
explanation.definitionFit: Amateurs are non-professionals, people lacking the skill or training of an expert.

clue.text: Pilot's instrument to measure duration and make changes outside

blocks.note: to alter is to make changes
to time something is to measure how long it lasts

explanation.surface: A cockpit gauge that clocks durations and can be adjusted from the outside.
explanation.definitionFit: An altimeter tells a pilot the aircraft's height above sea level, a key flight instrument.

explanation.definitionFit: An abyss is a chasm so deep it seems bottomless.

clue.text: Extra performance before capturing military figure

clue.text: Outspoken rule: "Male lover is a gay symbol"

clue.text: Notable's constituents repeatedly used a traveler's official paper

clue.text: "Looking at the eyes of a cat" in slightly rewritten poetry

explanation.walkthrough: 'Slightly' is fair: only the first two letters of the poem word change places. A tom is the usual crossword cat.

clue.text: Barrel maker took in work with others

clue.text: Denigrate flower: "It's a catastrophe"

clue.text: Incapacitate a demonstrator, perhaps, in just a second

clue.text: Premium stocks (or, the thing I consider most important)
